tickets.title: Review debt refinance opportunity
tickets.text: Run a structured refinance review for Mira Quillwhistle's first mortgage serviced by Whistling Pebble Mortgage. Confirm current loan terms, proposed terms, transaction costs, cash-flow impact, break-even period, tax considerations, and any collateral or credit implications before preparing a recommendation. Compare keeping the adjustable mortgage after the reset (rate moving from 4.125% to 7.375%, payment rising from $3,420 to about $4,920 on a $642,000 balance) against a fixed-rate refinance quote, including payment change, closing costs, break-even period, cash reserve impact, and fit with the household's retirement contribution goal.

subTasks.title: Gather current and proposed loan details
subTasks.text: Collect current balance, rate type, interest rate, payment, remaining term, prepayment penalties, collateral details, and proposed refinance terms from Mira Quillwhistle or Whistling Pebble Mortgage.

subTasks.title: Model cash-flow and break-even impact
subTasks.text: Compare monthly payment change, total interest cost, closing costs, break-even period, and liquidity impact under the current and proposed debt structures, including the reset payment of about $4,920.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor recommendation summary
subTasks.text: Summarize pros, cons, planning tradeoffs, open questions, and whether the refinance appears aligned with Mira Quillwhistle's goals and risk profile, including the retirement contribution goal.

tickets.evidence: Mira asked Apricot Compass Advisory to compare keeping the adjustable mortgage after the reset against a fixed-rate refinance quote, including payment change, closing costs, break-even period, cash reserve impact, and fit with the household’s retirement contribution goal; the agreed follow-up is due

tickets.title: Prepare short-term cash-flow bridge

Mira is uncomfortable letting cash reserves fall below $45,000.

tickets.title: Compare credit card payoff funding sources

Pay attention to the $45,000 cash reserve floor and concentration risk.
